name: request_human
description: Flag that this conversation needs a person: bulk quotes, order changes, complaints, anything about a specific customer's account or payment. Call it once, then tell the customer someone will pick it up.

tool.description: Which tool this call is for. One URL serves all four, so this is how the shop knows.

session_token.description: Issued by the conversation-initiation webhook. This tool is the one that most needs it: without the token the handoff is never recorded, so nobody on the shop's side learns the customer asked for a person.

reason.description: One line on what they need, for the staff picking it up.
